tool_args.rationale: Only u_now varies in the five pilot rows. The resulting saturation does not identify the two-hop transfer suggested by the mobility and flux-conservation signatures. The branch probe is the lowest-cost way to distinguish that mechanism from input-only saturation before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It can explain diminishing returns in the input sweep, but all five rows have the same gradient, so they cannot test its prediction of gradient independence.
At fixed x_now, it predicts a constant slope in u_now, whereas the observed slope decreases.
The $2.0 branch probe tests the specific ambiguity at lower cost than the $4.5 trajectory batch.
